records.title: AttriStory: Fine-Grained Attribute Realization for Visual Storytelling with Diffusion Models

content.summary: AttriStory pairs a benchmark of 200 five-scene stories across 10 artistic styles with AttriLoss, an inference-time method for binding requested attributes to the correct objects. It refines latent codes to align attribute–object attention during early diffusion steps, integrating with SDXL, ConsiStory and StoryDiffusion without retraining. With AttriLoss, StoryDiffusion VQAScore increased from 0.8363 to 0.8636 on the AttriStory benchmark (Table 1).
content.contribution: Manogna Sreenivas, Rohit Kumar, Soma Biswas. Co-first authors: Manogna Sreenivas and Rohit Kumar

metrics.label: Published Table 1 benchmark result
metrics.sample: AttriStory benchmark: 200 five-scene stories across 10 artistic styles.
metrics.context: Same StoryDiffusion baseline with and without inference-time AttriLoss; absolute score increase 0.0273.
limitations: Selected VQAScore result, not a claim that every metric improved.

records.title: TACLE: Task and Class-aware Exemplar-free Semi-supervised Class Incremental Learning

content.summary: TACLE learns new classes from few labels and current-task unlabeled data without retaining earlier examples. It combines task-adaptive pseudo-label selection, class-aware weighted losses and classifier alignment using labeled and confident pseudo-labeled data. Evaluated on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100 and ImageNet-Subset100, including one-shot and imbalanced settings. On CIFAR-100 with 0.8% labels over 10 tasks, TACLE reached 92.35% average incremental accuracy versus 88.23% for SLCA+FT (+4.12 percentage points; same ImageNet-pretrained ViT, Table 1).
content.problem: Learn new classes with few labels and current-task unlabeled data without retaining previous-class examples.
content.contribution: Jayateja Kalla*, Rohit Kumar*, Soma Biswas

limitations: Selected low-label benchmark setting, not a universal gain across datasets or label budgets.
